definitions.explanation: A journey to visit a series of temples, shrines, or other sacred places, often following an established route.

definitions.gloss: pilgrimage (anime/media), visiting real-life locations from fictional works
definitions.explanation: In modern usage, visiting real-world locations that appeared in anime, manga, films, or other media. Also called {聖地|せいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい}.

examples.japanese: {四国|しこく}{巡礼|じゅんれい}に{出|で}る。
examples.english: To set out on the Shikoku pilgrimage.

examples.japanese: {八十八|はちじゅうはち}か{所|しょ}の{巡礼|じゅんれい}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: I completed the pilgrimage to all eighty-eight temples.

examples.japanese: {巡礼|じゅんれい}{者|しゃ}が{白装束|しろしょうぞく}で{歩|ある}いていた。
examples.english: Pilgrims were walking in white robes.

examples.japanese: アニメの{聖地|せいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい}をする。
examples.english: To make a pilgrimage to anime locations.

examples.japanese: あの{映画|えいが}のファンが{聖地|せいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい}に{訪|おとず}れている。
examples.english: Fans of that movie are visiting the filming locations on pilgrimage.

examples.japanese: {聖地|せいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい}が{地方|ちほう}の{観光|かんこう}に{貢献|こうけん}するケースが{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Cases where anime pilgrimages contribute to local tourism are increasing.

notes:
CULTURAL CONTEXT:
The most famous Japanese pilgrimage is the {四国八十八|しこくはちじゅうはち}か{所|しょ}{巡|めぐ}り (Shikoku 88 Temple Pilgrimage), a roughly 1,200 km route visiting 88 Buddhist temples associated with {弘法大師|こうぼうだいし} (Kōbō Daishi).

MODERN USAGE:
{聖地|せいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい} ("sacred site pilgrimage") has become a major cultural phenomenon where fans visit real locations that appeared in anime, manga, or films. This has become a significant driver of regional tourism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{巡礼|じゅんれい}に{出|で}る (to set out on a pilgrimage)
・{巡礼|じゅんれい}{者|しゃ} (pilgrim)
・{聖地|せいち}{巡礼|じゅんれい} (sacred site pilgrimage / anime location pilgrimage)
